A '''temperature adjuster''' was a component used in the [[Roamer-6 breath mask/Legends|Roamer-6]] [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]]. It allowed the breathing apparatus to regulate the temperature of the air being breathed in by the wearer, either heating or chilling it as desired.<ref name="EGWT" />
